98058316.s: A traditional market known for distinctive fabrics and many shops specializing in gold. A traditional market. Open 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058316.b: Souq Al Quds is one of the largest wholesale fabric markets in Saudi Arabia, known for its distinctive fabrics and many shops specializing in gold. Fabrics are imported from many countries such as China, Indonesia, Thailand and India, alongside ready-made clothing and uniforms, which makes it a favorite destination for tailors and fashion shop owners buying in bulk. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058315.s: A complete traditional market with many varied shops selling goods and products. A traditional market. Open 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058315.b: AlMajd Market is a complete traditional market with many varied shops selling goods and products, and is known for gold at some of the best prices in Riyadh and for affordable abayas. It is near the famous Al Rajhi Mosque and has been a trusted destination for lovers of traditional shopping for many years. Contact: 0566660900. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058315.a: Eastern Ring Branch Rd, Ar Rabwah, Riyadh 12839

98058314.s: Draws large numbers of visitors for its reasonable prices and variety of goods. A traditional market. Open 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058314.b: Taiba Market draws large numbers of visitors for its reasonable prices and variety of goods, and is known for gold, abayas, perfumes and bags. It also has a mosque, a cafe and fresh juice shops. It does not sell vegetables or fruit, although the rest of everyday shopping needs are available. Contact: 0594589774. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058314.a: King Fahd Rd, King Fahd, Riyadh 11484

98058312.s: A complete traditional market known for high-quality local goods. A traditional market. Open 8:30 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058312.b: Uwais Markets is a complete traditional market known for high-quality local goods. It is on Olaya Street, in a spot overlooking one of the tallest buildings in Riyadh. It has shops for furniture, carpets, clothing and household items, and suits visitors who want to shop and compare prices. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058311.s: One of the best-known traditional markets in Riyadh, with many heritage and antique products, making it a destination for tourists. A traditional market. Open 3:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058311.b: Souk Al Zal is one of the oldest and best-known historic traditional markets in Riyadh. It is near the historic Masmak Fortress in the Deirah district, in the heart of the old city. The market is known for tools, men's clothing, rare pieces, antiques and old heritage items, making it a destination for tourists and collectors of antiques and heritage pieces. Public auctions are held here on Fridays for Arabic coffee and old heritage items, giving it an authentic atmosphere that reflects the heritage of old Riyadh. Open from 3:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058311.a: Al Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim, Ad Dirah, Riyadh 12634

98058310.s: One of the largest traditional markets in the region, with many kinds of commercial activity. A traditional market. Open 8:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058310.b: Al Qariah Al Shabiah is one of the largest traditional markets in the region, with many kinds of commercial activity, built in an architectural style dating back more than 500 years. It is especially known for women's shopping, with shops for furniture, gold, women's dresses, abayas and women's perfumes. Contact: 0114323000. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058310.a: Khadijah Bint Khuwailid Rd, Tuwaiq, Riyadh 14924

98058309.s: The long-established Al Mu'aiqliyah market is known for its varied goods and products. A traditional market. Open 9:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058309.b: The long-established Al Mu'aiqliyah market is known for its varied goods and products, and is one of the best places in Riyadh to shop for souvenirs. It surrounds the Qasr Al Hukm area and has shops selling carpets, oud, gold and clothing, as well as imitation pens of luxury brands. Contact: 0112221210. Open from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (varies by day).
98058309.a: Al Imam Muhammad Ibn Saoud Ibn Mouqren, Ad Dirah, Riyadh 12634

98058307.s: A complete market with everything a family and home need, and one of the oldest and largest traditional markets in Riyadh. A traditional market. Open 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058307.b: Taameer Market is a complete market with everything a family and home need, and is one of the oldest and largest traditional markets in Riyadh, with unique traditional architecture. It has a gold market and dozens of shops selling men's and women's clothing at low prices starting from SAR 5, along with spices, perfumes and authentic Arabic coffee. Contact: 0537072329. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058263.s: In a warm rural atmosphere, Beit Al Mounah offers a tasty and varied breakfast menu along with creative dairy products. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058263.b: Beit Al Mounah, in a warm rural atmosphere, offers a tasty and varied breakfast menu along with its own creative dairy products. It is known for high-quality manakish, falafel and hummus, and has very high reviews for the authentic, warm Arab atmosphere and good hospitality. For contact or reservations: 0535995050. Open from 5:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98058263.a: King Abdulaziz Branch Rd, Al Yasmeen, Riyadh 13326

98058262.s: With a modern Saudi character, known for serving tasty traditional breakfast with great indoor and outdoor seating. A breakfast restaurant. Open 5:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058262.b: Al Mutaka has a modern Saudi character and is known for serving tasty traditional breakfast with great indoor and outdoor seating. It is known for delicious lamb kabsa and fresh foul and hummus. It has economical prices and a friendly atmosphere. It is advisable to allow for peak times, given the many visitors and the service staff being stretched at times. For contact or reservations: 0118107772. Open from 5:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058262.a: Khalifah Ibn Badi, Al Takhassousi, Al Mohammadiyyah, Riyadh 12362

98058260.s: For an experience of Saudi hospitality, specializing in tasty breakfasts with a varied menu to suit all tastes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
98058260.b: Mirzam offers an experience of Saudi hospitality, specializing in tasty breakfasts with a varied menu to suit all tastes, and is known for scrambled eggs (bayd mighashsh) and sukkari date pudding. It serves a traditional Arabic shared breakfast platter suitable for two or three people, and ends your visit by offering incense as an authentic hospitality gesture. For contact or reservations: 0534187431. Open from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
98058260.a: Takamul Plaza, Al Takhassousi, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12383

98058258.s: For lovers of calm morning settings, serving a variety of breakfasts with distinctive outdoor and indoor seating. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058258.b: Maison de Cofleur is for lovers of calm morning settings, serving a variety of breakfasts with distinctive outdoor and indoor seating in a style reminiscent of tropical Bali. It is known for its eggs and giant pancakes, and its friendly service makes it a favorite for a slow weekend brunch. For contact or reservations: 0551842557. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058258.a: Abi Bakr As Siddiq Rd, An Nada, Riyadh 13317

98058239.s: Specializes in tasty breakfast sandwiches with varied fillings, along with a unique halloumi and berry pastry. A breakfast restaurant. Open 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058239.b: AGIA specializes in tasty breakfast sandwiches with varied fillings, along with a unique halloumi and berry pastry, and is known for its tuna sandwich and its galette with berries. It has a small, intimate setting with special attention to plants and artistic decor, and is a hidden gem for lovers of a quiet breakfast in Diriyah. For contact or reservations: 0550515696. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058239.a: King Fahad Rd, Al Faisaliyah, Diriyah 13712

98058237.s: With charming details throughout, serving delicious fresh pastries and baked goods as well as a tasty breakfast. A breakfast restaurant. Open 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058237.b: Ajinet Mariam has charming details throughout and serves delicious fresh pastries and baked goods as well as a tasty breakfast. It is known for its varied cheese manakish and the Mariam platter, rich in Lebanese mezze. It has indoor and outdoor seating and a calm terrace, and is a favorite for lovers of authentic Lebanese breakfast. For contact or reservations: 0532874129. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058237.a: Saeed Bin Zaid Rd, Qurtubah, Riyadh 13248

98058236.s: A welcoming bakery serving a varied menu of food and coffee of distinctive quality. A breakfast restaurant. Open 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058236.b: Al Hatab Bakery is a welcoming bakery serving a varied menu of food and coffee of distinctive quality. It is known for its protein bread, one of its best sellers, as well as keto bread options for special diets. It has been a trusted destination for many years for lovers of fresh baked goods in the city. For contact or reservations: 920002281. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98058234.s: A restaurant serving a wide range of tasty breakfast and brunch dishes of distinctive quality. A breakfast restaurant. Open 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98058234.b: Avenue M by FF is a restaurant serving a wide range of tasty breakfast and brunch dishes of distinctive quality, and is known for its Turkish eggs, poached eggs over mushrooms and fresh falafel. It has elegant French decor from the owners of the restaurant "Flour & Firewood", and it is advisable to download the booking app to join the waiting queue in advance. For contact or reservations: 0550891599. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98058234.a: Prince Sultan Bin Abdulaziz Rd, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12232

98058233.s: Specializes in French toast with many flavors and delicious fillings, with distinctive seating views. A breakfast restaurant. Open 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058233.b: French Toast & Co specializes in French toast with many flavors and delicious fillings, with distinctive seating views, and is known for its French toast cheesecake and eggs Benedict with hollandaise sauce. It has a special warm atmosphere upstairs and has been a well-established breakfast destination in the city for more than three years. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058233.a: Abi Bakr As Siddiq Rd, An Nada, Riyadh 13317

98058197.s: A restaurant serving breakfast dishes and coffee, known for delicious food. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058197.b: Bellbird is a restaurant serving breakfast dishes and coffee, known for delicious food, and is famous for its sticky toffee pudding, the Riyadh Sunrise juice and truffle fries. It is very popular with heavy daily crowds, although its menu is relatively limited for its level of fame. For contact or reservations: 0550830061. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058197.a: Al Thoumamah Rd, Ar Rabi, Riyadh 13315

98058195.s: Serves an international menu with a variety of breakfast dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058195.b: Stir serves an international menu with a variety of breakfast dishes, and is known for its brioche Benedict brunch, Spanish omelette and delicious babka. It offers complimentary welcome scones to visitors, and is one of the best breakfast destinations in Riyadh according to its loyal customers. For contact or reservations: 0551890677. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058195.a: Jarir Complex, Eastern Ring Branch Rd, Ar Rawdah, Riyadh 13213

98058193.s: A cafe and restaurant serving coffee, organic tea and gluten-free dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058193.b: Urth Caffé is a cafe and restaurant serving coffee, organic tea and gluten-free dishes, and is known for its chocolate cake, Oreo cheesecake and lemon tart. It has a calm, elegant atmosphere suited to breakfast or watching sports matches, and is very popular as an upscale coffee destination on Tahlia Street. For contact or reservations: 920007498. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 1:30 a.m.
98058193.a: Prince Muhammad Ibn Abdulaziz, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12243

98058192.s: A restaurant serving a varied breakfast menu in a traditional atmosphere. A breakfast restaurant. Open 4:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98058192.b: Tamisa is a restaurant serving a varied breakfast menu in an authentic traditional atmosphere, and is known for foul, tamees bread and milky tea. It opens very early, from dawn until the afternoon, to suit early-morning breakfast-goers, and is a trusted, economical choice for lovers of traditional local food. For contact or reservations: 0501631447. Open from 4:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.

98058191.s: A distinctive restaurant offering a special international breakfast and brunch experience. A breakfast restaurant. Open 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058191.b: Chapter is a distinctive restaurant offering a special international breakfast and brunch experience, and is known for its grilled camembert, fig toast with honey and Turkish eggs (cilbir). It serves two different menus depending on the time (breakfast and an evening burger menu), and has an elegant, upscale atmosphere, although parking can be hard to find at times. For contact or reservations: 0530777316. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058191.a: Al Thoumamah Rd, Ar Rabi, Riyadh 13315

98058189.s: Specializes in tasty healthy meals alongside many fresh juices. A breakfast restaurant. Open 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058189.b: The Health Bar specializes in tasty healthy meals alongside many fresh juices, and is known for its chicken and peach salad and grilled chicken with teriyaki sauce. It has large windows and lovely natural light that give it a refreshing daytime atmosphere, and is a good destination for healthy-eating fans, although prices are slightly high. For contact or reservations: 0535567011. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 a.m.

98058188.s: Specializes in traditional breakfast meals and is known for foul and liver. A breakfast restaurant. Open 5:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058188.b: Faris Breakfast specializes in traditional breakfast meals and is known for foul and liver, along with labneh, hummus and feta cheese. It has comfortable decor and an intimate atmosphere, and caters to special needs such as gluten-free options with advance request. For contact or reservations: 0590420267. Open from 5:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98058188.a: King Abdullah Rd, Al Hamra, Riyadh 13216

98058185.s: A restaurant specializing in falafel, with a variety of additional dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058185.b: Operation Falafel is a restaurant specializing in falafel, with a variety of additional dishes such as shared lunch platters. It is known for its friendly service and small surprises such as free dessert for visitors, and is very popular for breakfast, especially among students at nearby universities. For contact or reservations: 0112465709. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058185.a: Northern Ring Branch Rd, Hittin, Riyadh 13512
